# awesome-free-ai-coding

> Legal free LLM APIs and coding agents for AI coding — free tiers, no-card trials and free models, probe-verified twice a week against live model catalogs and pricing pages. Generated 2026-09-23 from the registry; every offer above the Archived heading passed a probe in the last 60 days and has not failed 3 in a row.

Each offer links to a page with the free tier in the vendor's own words, the connection details (base URL, where to get a key, model ids, an Anthropic-format URL where the vendor documents one), the evidence the probe reads and the row's history. "No card" means the vendor asks for no payment method; "no key" means the endpoint answers without an account; "no account" means the vendor prints a key anyone may call it with. Offers the list carried and carries no more are listed last, under Archived, each with why it left.

## Coding agents & CLIs

- [opencode](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/opencode/): Open-source coding agent whose opencode Zen gateway prices a rotating set of models at zero — Big Pickle, MiMo-V2.5, Ling 3.0 Flash Fin, Nemotron 3 Ultra, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor — inside OpenCode only, no sign-in; any provider via BYOK; no card; what you send may be used to train models; free models: `big-pickle`, `mimo-v2.5`, `ling-3.0-flash-fin`, `nemotron-3-ultra`, `nemotron-3.5-lightning`, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`
- [Kilo Code](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/kilo-code/): Open-source VS Code / JetBrains / CLI agent whose $0 plan routes "Auto Free" to the models the Kilo Gateway marks free; the same gateway serves them to any OpenAI client without a key, with BYOK and local models alongside; no card; what you send may be used to train models; no key; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.kilo.ai/api/gateway; free models: `nemotron-3-ultra`, `nemotron-3-super`, `north-mini-code`, `step-3.7-flash`, `laguna-s-2.1`, `laguna-xs-2.1`
- [Google Antigravity](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/antigravity/): Google's agent-first IDE and CLI, and where the Gemini CLI free tier went — Gemini CLI and the Code Assist IDE extensions stopped serving free, AI Pro and Ultra users on 2026-06-18. The $0 Individual plan carries the same agent models the paid ones do; no card; what you send may be used to train models unless you opt out; free models: `gemini-3.1-pro`, `gemini-3.8-flash`, `gemini-3.7-flash`, `gemini-3.6-flash`, `claude-opus-4.6`, `claude-sonnet-4.6`, `gpt-oss`
- [Freebuff](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/freebuff/): Ad-funded coding agent — CLI, desktop, web, cloud and chat — with no API key and no card; GLM 5.3 Flash by default, with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GPT-5.6 Luna, MiMo 2.6 and Gemini 3.8 Flash in the picker; no card; what you send may be used to train models; free models: `glm-5.3-flash`, `deepseek-v4.1-flash`, `gpt-5.6-luna`
- [Cline](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/cline/): Open-source coding agent for VS Code, JetBrains and the terminal; signing in to its own Cline provider unlocks a rotating set of free models, each with a daily allowance, beside pay-as-you-go credits, the $9.99 ClinePass plan and BYOK; no card; what you send may be used to train models; provisional since 2026-09-14
- [OpenAI Codex CLI](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/openai-codex-cli/): Open-source coding CLI, free by signing in with a $0 ChatGPT Free account; local coding tasks included on all plans; no card; free models: `gpt-5.6`
- [Amazon Q Developer](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/amazon-q-developer/): AWS's coding assistant in the IDE and the CLI; its perpetual Free Tier gives a Builder ID user 50 agentic requests a month; no card; what you send may be used to train models unless you opt out; provisional since 2026-09-16
- [Crush + Charm Hyper](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/charm-hyper/): Charm's Crush terminal agent with Hyper, its official hosted model gateway; the free plan includes monthly Hypercredits, zero data retention; no card; what you send is not used to train models
- [CodeGPT](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/codegpt/): VS Code / JetBrains coding agent whose $0 plan includes model usage rather than only BYOK — a small daily allowance on its own Economy models, plus BYOK across 15+ providers and local models (Ollama, LM Studio) beside it; no card

- [Inception Labs (Mercury)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/inception-labs/): A signup grant on the Mercury diffusion models — Mercury 2.5 and Mercury 2 for chat, Mercury Edit 2 for fill-in-the-middle and code edits; the last is the reason this row is here, since an FIM endpoint is what an IDE completion plugin actually calls; no card; what you send may be used to train models unless you opt out; key from https://platform.inceptionlabs.ai; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.inceptionlabs.ai/v1; free models: `mercury-2.5`, `mercury-2`, `mercury-edit-2`
- [Blue Claw Network](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/blue-claw/): OpenAI-compatible endpoint that routes calls to a network of independent GPU operators running open models; every new account starts with a $5 welcome credit, and no card is asked to start; no card; key from https://portal.blueclaw.network/; OpenAI-compatible at https://openai.blueclaw.network/v1; provisional since 2026-09-17
- [Fireworks AI](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/fireworks-ai/): Serverless inference on open-weight models — Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash among them — with a one-time $1 of credit that is spent without a card, at 10 requests a minute until a payment method is added; no card; what you send is not used to train models; key from https://app.fireworks.ai/settings/users/api-keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1; Anthropic Messages at https://api.fireworks.ai/inference; provisional since 2026-09-17
- [RouterPlex](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/routerplex/): A one-time $1 of free credit on a prepaid reseller that bills 56 models at catalog rates with 0% markup, no card — one key on both wires, OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and an Anthropic Messages base Claude Code takes as it is; no card; what you send is not used to train models; key from https://routerplex.com/sign-up; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.routerplex.com/v1; Anthropic Messages at https://api.routerplex.com; provisional since 2026-09-11
- [abliteration.ai](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/abliteration-ai/): OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API for three uncensored reasoning models, the large one derived from GLM-5.3, that opens with a one-credit free preview and no card; no card; what you send is not used to train models; key from https://abliteration.ai/console; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.abliteration.ai/v1; Anthropic Messages at https://api.abliteration.ai; provisional since 2026-09-17
- [Impossibl](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/impossibl/): Prepaid gateway at provider list prices over 128 models, Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and GLM among them, whose keyless sign-up funds an account with $0.05 and adds $1 once a person claims it by email — no card; no card; key from https://impossibl.com/dashboard; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.impossibl.com/v1; Anthropic Messages at https://api.impossibl.com; provisional since 2026-09-17
- [Standard Compute](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/standardcompute/): A one-time $0.25 of smart-routed compute on a flat-rate agent gateway, no card — a real key on both wires, OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and an Anthropic Messages base Claude Code takes as it is; no card; what you send is not used to train models; key from https://standardcompute.com/signup; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.stdcmpt.com/v1; Anthropic Messages at https://api.stdcmpt.com

## Aggregators (one key, many providers)

- [OpenRouter (free models)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/openrouter-free/): One API key for a rotating set of :free model variants, open-weight and stealth models among them; no card; what you send may be used to train models unless you opt out; key from https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://openrouter.ai/api/v1; Anthropic Messages at https://openrouter.ai/api; free models: `nemotron-3-ultra`, `gemma-4`
- [Requesty](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/requesty/): OpenAI-compatible router over a 690+ model catalog with routing, caching and fallbacks; twelve rows in it are priced 0 and the free plan is the same gateway restricted to those; no card; what you send may be used to train models; key from https://app.requesty.ai/api-keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://router.requesty.ai/v1; Anthropic Messages at https://router.requesty.ai; free models: `nemotron-3-ultra`, `nemotron-3-super`, `gemma-4`, `ling-3.0-tiny`, `muse-glimmer-30b`, `nemotron-3.5-lightning`
- [AIHubMix (free models)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/aihubmix/): One OpenAI-compatible gateway over 800+ models, dozens of which the platform prices at 0 and subsidises itself — GLM-5.3 and Kimi K3 coding routes among them — with an Anthropic-format /v1/messages too, so a free id can back Claude Code; no card; key from https://aihubmix.com/token; OpenAI-compatible at https://aihubmix.com/v1; Anthropic Messages at https://aihubmix.com; free models: `glm-5.3`, `kimi-k3`, `glm-5`, `mimo-v2.5`, `north-mini-code`
- [Routeway](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/routeway/): OpenAI-compatible gateway whose :free lane rotates — three zero-priced chat models on 2026-09-23, Meta's Muse Glimmer 30B, DeepSeek V4 Flash and MiniMax M2.7 — beside 269 metered rows in the same catalog; no card; key from https://routeway.ai/dashboard/keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.routeway.ai/v1; free models: `deepseek-v4-flash`, `minimax-m2.7`, `muse-glimmer-30b`
- [LLMTR](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/llmtr/): Turkish OpenAI-compatible gateway whose free rows answer on a zero balance — nine zero-priced chat ids on 2026-09-23, Nemotron 3 Ultra, Qwen3.8 27B and Agnes 3.0 Flash among them; no card; what you send may be used to train models; key from https://llmtr.com/dashboard/api-keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://llmtr.com/v1; free models: `nemotron-3-ultra`
- [Vercel AI Gateway](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/vercel-ai-gateway/): One OpenAI-compatible endpoint for 360+ models, with $5 of gateway credits included every month and three language models that never touch the credit; no card; what you send may be used to train models unless you opt out; key from https://vercel.com/dashboard/ai-gateway/api-keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1; Anthropic Messages at https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh; free models: `laguna-s-2.1`, `ling-3.0-flash-fin`, `ling-3.0-flash-sante`
- [BazaarLink](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/bazaarlink/): OpenAI-compatible gateway to a 173-id catalog whose free page counts two models on 2026-09-14 — Qwen3.7 Flash and DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 — beside the auto:free router; no card; key from https://bazaarlink.ai/keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.bazaarlink.ai/v1; free models: `qwen3.7-flash`
- [Nous Portal (Hermes Agent)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/nous-portal/): Nous Research's inference portal behind its Hermes Agent: a $0 Free plan limited to the models it prices at zero — seven on 2026-09-18, Step 3.7 Flash and Laguna S 2.1 among them — on an OpenAI-compatible API; no card; what you send may be used to train models unless you opt out; key from https://portal.nousresearch.com; OpenAI-compatible at https://inference-api.nousresearch.com/v1; free models: `step-3.7-flash`, `laguna-s-2.1`; provisional since 2026-09-16
- [TokenRouter (PaleBlueDot)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/tokenrouter/): One zero-priced id — Nemotron 3 Nano Omni, in the default group — inside a 140-row catalog that meters the rest; no card; key from https://www.tokenrouter.com/console/token; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.tokenrouter.com/v1; free models: `nemotron-3-nano-omni`

## Archived

- [AI21 Labs (Jamba)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/ai21-labs/): no longer listed — vendor-announced shutdown on 2026-08-09
- [Aider](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/aider/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-07-19: BYOK only — the tool is free and open source but bundles no model access of its own, and its docs send readers to other vendors' free tiers, which this list carries directly
- [Cerebras Inference](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/cerebras-free/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-09-16: its only free offer was $5 of credit granted after a verified payment method is added, expiring in 30 days — a one-off credit behind a card, which CONTRIBUTING does not admit
- [DeepSeek Platform](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/deepseek/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-07-27: the 5M-token signup grant was only ever reported by third parties, and DeepSeek's own pricing page prices every model and names no free grant
- [Easy GonkaAI API](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/easy-gonka-api/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-07-19: rejected for cause — its /for-agents page carried a prompt injection aimed at AI agents (auto-signup, credential exfiltration, referral spam)
- [GitHub Models](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/github-models/): no longer listed — vendor-announced shutdown on 2026-06-16
- [Infomaniak AI Services](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/infomaniak-ai/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-09-16: a one-month wallet of a million credits, and "A credit card is required to start using the API" — a one-off credit behind a card, which CONTRIBUTING does not admit
- [Kenari](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/kenari/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-09-16: rejected for cause — the operator's own JavaScript bundle showed its capacity coming from pooled ChatGPT and Codex OAuth credentials, captcha solvers and a proxy pool that multiplies per-IP free quotas
- [LongCat API Platform](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/longcat/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-08-14: the daily free quota was gone before the row was listed — the change log retired the Flash line on 2026-05-29 and switched billing on for LongCat-2.0 on 2026-06-30, and no LongCat page still published the 100K tokens a day
- [MiMo Code](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/mimo-code/): no longer listed — vendor-announced shutdown on 2026-07-26
- [Novita AI](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/novita/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-08-14: the free lane ended without an announcement — both models the row named free were billed, and not one of the 102 prices on novita.ai/pricing was zero
- [Puter.js (free LLM API)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/puter-free/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-07-19: a browser SDK billed to each end user's Puter account, with no HTTP endpoint a coding agent could call; the OpenAI-compatible endpoint read on 2026-09-14 needs a paid plan
- [Reka AI](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/reka/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-08-11: the $10 of free credits a month rested on one dated announcement post; no live Reka page corroborated a recurring grant, and the platform sells pay-as-you-go credits
- [Scaleway Generative APIs](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/scaleway-generative/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-09-16: 1,000,000 free tokens once per customer, and "Ordering Scaleway resources requires a valid credit card" — a one-off credit behind a card, which CONTRIBUTING does not admit

## Machine-readable

- [index.json](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/index.json): every row with its connection details and probe, plus the watchlist of services considered and not listed
- [feed.xml](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/feed.xml): Atom feed of every change — rows arriving, leaving and changing their free models
- [Provider pages](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/): one page per row, live and archived
- [Filterable table](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/browse.html): the same rows filtered by category, card, key and API format
- [configs/opencode.json](https://github.com/mvalentsev/awesome-free-ai-coding/blob/main/configs/opencode.json): opencode config with every OpenAI-compatible row wired up
- [configs/claude-code.sh](https://github.com/mvalentsev/awesome-free-ai-coding/blob/main/configs/claude-code.sh): one shell function per gateway that serves the Anthropic Messages format, for Claude Code
- [configs/litellm.yaml](https://github.com/mvalentsev/awesome-free-ai-coding/blob/main/configs/litellm.yaml): LiteLLM proxy config over the same rows, with one-name fallback groups (free/strong, free/nokey)
- [README](https://github.com/mvalentsev/awesome-free-ai-coding): the list itself, with the picks table and how it stays fresh
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/mvalentsev/awesome-free-ai-coding/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): what qualifies, how rows are ranked, how the probes work
